summary.text: Caitlyn Sanow-Minett is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Chris Knoll.
According to her campaign website, she is a lifelong southwest Minnesota resident who works as circulation supervisor at an academic library.

paragraphs.text: Sanow-Minett writes on her campaign website that she grew up in Tracy and attended Bethany Lutheran College before earning a B.A. in English Literature from Southwest Minnesota State University.
She says her background includes childcare, hospitality management and higher education, and that she is a leader within her local union.
She lives in Lake Benton with her husband, Eric.
Her campaign lists three priorities: rural communities, balance rather than extremes, and transparent government.
